title: CLO 2024 Academic Month 3D Clothing Tools and Apparel Category Design Concepts
description: CLO Academic Month 2024 Review! In a conversation with Mr. Yang Yi, Modeling Director of the Digital Team at Jiangsu Shuntian Co., Ltd., he discussed the company's comprehensive requirements for designers amid the digital transformation in the apparel industry. When designers possess skills in design, pattern knowledge, and CLO software, they can more effectively and sustainably contribute to the development of the apparel industry through a digital workflow. Additionally, this new type of talent, which integrates all three skills, has better prospects for development. Moreover, Mr. Yang provided insights from the perspective of a commercial designer on the customer group needs that must be considered in design, aiding the learning and growth of 3D designers in the apparel industry.

summary: # CLO 2024 Academic Month 3D Clothing Tools and Apparel Category Design Concepts ## Introduction Hello, everyone. I am Yang Yi from Shuntian Group, Jiangsu Province. I am currently working on the 3D digitalization of clothing. Today, I would like to share with you the concept of 3D clothing tools and clothing design. ## The Digital Wave in the Clothing Industry As you all know, the digital wave has already swept across various industries, including our clothing industry. For example, the CROA 4-core that we used before, and the AI tools that will appear in the future, are all part of our digitalization process. Creating new technologies and using new technologies is inevitable for human progress. The digital wave of 3D to 2D virtual reality is emerging in various fields. From the development of design to the end of sales, the clothing industry is evolving towards 3D digitalization. The fashion industry is evolving towards 3D digitalization. ## Benefits of 3D Digitalization Currently, most of the development of our company is based on digitalized tools. It can reduce the cost of materials and human resources, shorten the period of the release of our products, increase the efficiency of the system, and increase the acceptance rate of our clothing. Some companies abroad, such as Google and Amazon, are also actively developing AI designers. They want to use fashion trend reports, trend data, image analysis, and so on, to create an AI designer. Although currently, these tools and software may only assist designers, I believe that after a global update, they will make a huge contribution to the fashion industry. ## AIGC Technology in Fashion At the same time, we can also use AIGC technology to match different clothing design styles and make individualized predictions to help the fashion industry judge the quality of products. For example, the American fashion brand Tommy recently announced that it will cooperate with IBM and the New York Fashion Institute (FIT) to use IBM's technology to carry out fashion decoding. AIGC, as the current new content, has been widely used in many industries, including smart offices, technology education, automated production, smart medicine, and, of course, our clothing industry. ## AIGC Processes in Our Company Currently, our company, AIGC, has three processes: 1. **Planning and Strategy**: In the planning phase, we may use big data from the Internet or trend data to conduct trend analysis, leading to insights on color trends, industry trends, and design trends, which connect to our development process. 2. **Design and Development**: In the development process, we may utilize insights from the planning phase to inform design, leading to unexpected trends. 3. **Product Marketing**: Once these trends go online or are sold on the Internet, we can use AIGC technology to produce online videos or sales content. These applications are inseparable from our software tools, allowing us to leverage AIGC technology for online content production. ## Software Tools Used in Design Here, I have compiled some of the software that we are currently using. Some of these tools you may be familiar with, such as: - **MD** - **Clo** - **Stealth 3D** - **ET** - **Blender** There are also some that have just become popular, such as Mid Journey and Stable Diffusion. Additionally, there may be some tools you haven't seen before, such as Houdini, 3D Max, and Maya. In the past few years, we have been designing clothes using traditional design software, such as AIPS or Procreate. However, in the past two years, all of our clothing design software has undergone significant revisions. We have utilized ET, Fuyi, and CAD software for clothing design. ### Tools for Clothing Models and Accessories For example, we have used CCD, Blender, 3D Max, or Maya to design clothing models, accessories, and modeling. We have also used Pixblend, AI, and PS to design fabrics and prints. Finally, we have used MD, Clo, Stealth 3D, and Blozeville for 3D clothing design. ## Project Collaboration and Outcomes On the right, you can see the project that we have recently collaborated on. One of the requirements of this project is to create a thin, airy, and cool design for the sun visor. When modeling, we choose a relatively thin fabric to create a semi-thin effect. In Maya and 3D Max, we created an ice-cold background and added strong sunlight. Finally, in Blender and Houdini, we simulated the thinness of the floating fabric and completed a series of visual designs. ## Evaluating the Impact of Digital Tools But can our process really have such an effect? A few days ago, a friend of mine asked me if we calculated how much cost we could save or how much we could speed up our company's efficiency or progress after using these digital software. After some reflection, I compared the time spent developing designs and the selection rate of our designs. When we didn't use 3D, it might take about 14 to 15 days to complete a sample. However, after starting to use 3D software in 2019, the process has only improved slightly, taking about 13.5 working days to produce a sample. ## Optimization of Design Processes To optimize the design process, we have conducted experiments. Some designers can produce two to three, or even three to four samples a week, while others who know how to model a 3D model may produce a sample in four to five days. For example, using simple board operations in Pro software, a 3D model can be created in about ten minutes, including hardware design and material confirmation. This allows for a much shorter sample production period, as the board can directly connect to our printer for sample creation. ## Challenges for New Designers However, we also encountered challenges. Many designers come from non-technical backgrounds and may struggle with the software. This raises questions about how to improve design efficiency without losing creativity. ## Design Philosophy in the Digital Age To address these challenges, it is important to understand the logic of design, which is to categorize needs effectively. The design criteria should be based on the needs of people, satisfying specific needs for different clothes in various situations. ### Analyzing Consumer Needs We categorize needs based on beauty, professionalism, flexibility, empathy, and comfort. This analysis helps us identify the medical life plan—what people wear daily and how it relates to their activities. ## Trends in Clothing Design Once we have the design criteria, we can create specific designs based on the type of people we are targeting. This includes understanding patterns, craftsmanship, fabric selection, and color trends. ## Key Components of Clothing Design 1. **Pattern**: The choice of patterns should reflect the audience's preferences and the context of use. 2. **Craftsmanship**: We must balance traditional and new craftsmanship techniques. 3. **Fabric**: Fabric choices should meet both functional and aesthetic needs. 4. **Color**: The color palette should align with current trends and consumer preferences. ## Conclusion In the end, I would like to talk about the future of 3D fashion designers. Many students have expressed concerns about their future in the industry. I believe that as we learn to digitalize fashion, opportunities will arise in various directions, including small designer brands, big fashion houses, and trade companies. Digital automation is a significant trend in the business world. For fashion companies, optimizing strategies, enhancing customer engagement, and innovating business models will all be driven by data. The fashion industry must quickly embrace digital transformation to unlock new business methods and communication channels. Thank you, everyone. I have finished my sharing.
